sentences.en: White eyeliner was, at one time, only used by professional makeup artists to accentuate the inner rim, widening and enlarging the eyes.

sentences.en: Another option is to use gold or bronze shadow to accentuate a dark brown smoky eye.

sentences.en: In either case, powder can be applied on top of the foundation to accentuate the pale skin.
